First look: Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc.

CMG-firstlook-2026-10-19 · USD · series 2026-10-20T05:26:46Z · built 2026-10-20 19:02 UTC

Chipotle owns and runs all of its restaurants in the U.S. and Canada instead of franchising them. Its only partner-run restaurants are 14 in the Middle East. Almost all of its revenue (about 99.5%) is food and drink, and delivery fees make up the rest. Revenue went from $5.6 billion in 2019 to $11.9 billion in 2025. Net income went from $350 million to $1.54 billion over the same years. Free cash flow was $1.45 billion in 2025.

The diluted share count has fallen from about 1.41 billion in 2019 to 1.28 billion in the second quarter of 2026, after adjusting for the 50-for-1 split in June 2024. In the week of Oct 12, the stock traded at about 28 times trailing earnings. This is a first look at the reported numbers only. It has no thesis and no buy range.

Open gaps

  • Q3 2026 not reported yet
  • Weekly P/E starts in late March 2016, once four quarters of EPS exist
  • Weekly P/FCF starts in late March 2016, once four quarters of free cash flow exist

Definitions

  • Diluted EPS: Net income divided by diluted weighted-average shares for the period, as printed.
  • Diluted weighted-average shares: The period’s diluted weighted-average share count, as printed in the filing or IR release.
  • TTM: Trailing twelve months: the sum of four consecutive quarters, or the printed fiscal-year figure for Q4 EPS.
  • FCF: Free cash flow is cash from operations minus capital expenditure (CFO − capex).
  • Weekly P/E: Weekly volume-weighted average price divided by trailing-twelve-month diluted EPS.
  • P/FCF: Weekly volume-weighted average price divided by trailing-twelve-month free cash flow per diluted share.
  • CAGR: Compound annual growth rate over the last five complete fiscal years when those years are printed.
  • 50-for-1 split adjustment (June 2024): A 50-for-1 split effective June 2024; earlier per-share figures are shown on the post-split basis.

Latest week TTM

The latest weekly P/E and P/FCF (week of Oct 12, 2026) use results through June 30, 2026.
